riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits responsible, careful people who do not avoid field conditions. Every additional check reduces risk at the dinner table, giving the work substantial meaning.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work is protecting the food-safety boundary. Every additional check reduces risk at the dinner table. People who value stability, accept responsibility, and tolerate site conditions can find both reassurance and meaning here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Conventional C + Realistic R + Investigative I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「责任心强、细心、不怕现场」的人——你多较真一分，餐桌上的风险就少一分，这份工作有沉甸甸的意义。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「守食品安全底线」：你多较真一分，餐桌上的风险就少一分。喜欢稳定、有责任心、能忍受现场环境的人，会在这里找到职业的踏实感和意义感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 常规型 C + 实际型 R + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy energetic on-site operations. An on-time departure and orderly cargo hold make the day's effort immediately visible, while teamwork and ramp activity create its appeal.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most tangible reward is visible after every shift: an on-time departure with every item accounted for. Ramp work is fast and weather changes, but coordinated teams can handle even heavy cargo volumes smoothly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢现场热火朝天」的人——航班正点推出、货舱装得整整齐齐，一天的辛苦当场兑现，团队配合的默契感和机坪的动感是这份工作的魅力。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的是「每一班都看得见成果」：航班正点推出、货物一件不少，一天的辛苦立刻有交代。机坪作业节奏快、天气多变，但团队配合默契了，再大的货量也能从容应对。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology And Product Development Managers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine process expertise, management ability, and coordination skills. Technology must advance effectively and teams must operate smoothly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops the ability to bridge technology and business. You need to understand chemical and biological processes while allocating resources and tracking regulations. It suits people who can lead research and development.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers enterprising, investigative, and practical work (Enterprising E + Investigative I + Realistic R).

breadcrumb.label: 生物燃料/生物柴油技术与产品开发经理

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「懂工艺 + 会管理 + 能协调」凑一块的人——技术要推得动，团队要带得顺。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在技术与商业间搭桥」——既要懂化工与生物工艺，也要会排资源、跟法规。适合能把研发管起来的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好企业、研究、实际（企业 E + 研究 I + 实际 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Lasting enthusiasm comes from the unknown: the moment a hypothesis is validated, the satisfaction of peer recognition, and watching successive classes of students grow in biology. Those rewards can become more compelling than a paycheck.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling part of this occupation is working alongside curiosity. A validated experimental hypothesis, an accepted paper, or a student finding direction can provide lasting satisfaction. The tradeoff is that the laboratory always has unfinished work, so conventional boundaries around leaving work are weak.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Social S + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最持久的热爱来自「未知」：一个实验假设被验证的瞬间，一篇文章被同行认可的满足，还有看着一届届学生在生物领域成长——这些比工资单更让人上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「和好奇心做同事」：一个实验假设被验证、一篇文章被接收、一个学生从迷茫到找到方向，每一样都能带来持续的满足感；但也意味着没有「下班」概念，实验室里永远有事。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who tolerate solitude and follow procedures. You control the rhythm of vessel passage, and consistent punctuality becomes a mark of professional pride.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying part of the work is following procedures to guide every vessel through safely. When the gate opens and a vessel passes steadily, you know you contributed to that waterborne journey.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「耐得住独处、守得住规程」的人——江面上过船的节奏由你掌握，日复一日的准点就是你的职业勋章。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「按规程把每艘船送过去」——闸门缓缓打开、船稳稳驶过的那一刻，你知道这趟水上运输有你的一份。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines attention to detail, order, and willingness to learn software. Drawings must be clear and standards correct because one wrong line can cause site rework.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career suits people who can sit for long periods, notice detail, and value order in drawings. Turning a disorganized idea into clear lines and then seeing the drawing become a real building creates strong satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, orderly, and analytical preferences (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 秩序感 + 愿学软件」凑一块的人——图面要清，规范要对，错一笔现场就返工。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合坐得住、细心、又对「图面世界」有秩序感的人。你喜欢把杂乱的想法理成清晰的线，看到自己画的图变成实体建筑，满足感很强。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、重秩序也研究（现实型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who are comfortable at both a lectern and a laboratory bench. They can explain a problem clearly to a group and work alone with a difficult dataset.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying moment is when a student truly understands a concept. A student who began without a clear idea of ecology can learn to design a sampling plan. Teachers also stay close to current research, making the career a strong fit for people who enjoy explaining ideas and investigating questions.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「讲台和实验台都坐得住」的人——既能当众把问题讲清楚，也能独自和一组数据较劲。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最让人满足的是「把学生教明白的那一刻」——一个对生态没概念的学生，听你讲完能自己设计采样方案，那种传承感很强。同时自己还能在科研一线保持新鲜感，适合爱讲又爱钻的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Film And Video Editors are worth considering if you remain curious about editing and accept the judgment required at moderate AI exposure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops both hands-on and visual skill. Professionals need composition and lighting ability as well as editing rhythm. It suits people with physical stamina, strong visual standards, and comfort with long periods at a workstation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers creative expression, hands-on implementation, and orderly processes (Artistic A + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Film And Video Editors有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，影视剪辑师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「既动手也动眼」——既要会构图用光，也要剪出节奏。适合体力还行、对画面有执念、又不排斥久坐的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造表达、动手实现、也重工序（艺术 A + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Weapons Specialists/Crew Members

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who combine leadership, equipment knowledge, and accountability. Tasks must be clear and safety rules must be enforced without compromise.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work centers on leading people and taking responsibility. Even the best equipment misses its target when a crew fails to coordinate. It suits people with a frontline leader's mindset, accountability, and equipment knowledge. Leadership is the foundation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefer making decisions, maintaining order, and working hands-on (Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional S).

breadcrumb.label: 一线主管（武器专业人员/机组人员）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「领导力 + 懂装备 + 能扛责」凑一块的人——任务要分得清，安全要卡得死。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最讲的是「带人与兜底」——装备再好，班组配合不到位就打不准。适合有兵头将尾意识、能扛责、又懂装备的人， leadership 是底色。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好做决策、也重秩序与动手（企业 E + 现实 R + 常规 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This industry is suitable for people who enjoy "turning strangers into trust" - your customer pool and reputation are compound interest assets that get bigger and bigger.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The charm of this industry is that "people connections are assets" - your customer pool, referral network, and reputation are the capital you accumulate more and more. People who like to deal with people, can handle performance pressure, and enjoy the moment of closing a deal will find a sense of explosion here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「把陌生变成信任」的人——你的客户池和口碑，是越攒越厚的复利资产。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在于「人脉即资产」——你的客户池、转介绍网络和口碑，是越攒越厚的本钱。喜欢和人打交道、能扛业绩压力、享受成交那一刻的人，会在这里找到爆发感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who like clear output and tolerate workshop conditions. Every qualified part becomes that day's report card.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The tangible reward comes from visible piece-rate output. Before leaving, you know how many parts you produced and the qualification rate. It suits quick, hands-on people who adapt to shifts and enjoy measurable output.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢有明确产出、不怕车间环境」的人——每一件合格零件都是你今天的成绩单。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的实在感在「计件看得见」——今天做了多少件、合格率多少，下班前心里都有数。适合动手快、适应倒班、喜欢有明确产出的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine a love of machinery, hands-on ability, and the capacity for hard work. Repairing a broken large machine yourself brings a deep sense of reassurance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops precision in dirty work. You must disassemble machinery in oil and mud while understanding circuit and hydraulic diagrams. It suits people who love machinery, dislike sitting in an office, instinctively want to repair broken large equipment, and enjoy the tangible satisfaction of getting a machine fixed so work can continue.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱机械 + 动手 + 能扛活」凑一块的人——大设备坏了自己修好，比啥都踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「脏活里的精准」——既要在油泥里拆得动，也要读得懂电路和液压图。适合爱机械、坐不住办公室、看见大设备坏就想去修的人，也享受「修好一台、工地接着干」的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实干、钻研、也讲条理（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine attention to detail, dependability, and a strong sense of rules. Documents must be verified and entered accurately, requiring a balance of efficiency and compliance and clear communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops attention to detail and respect for rules. Identity documents must be authentic, information must be entered accurately, and compliance must be strictly maintained. It suits careful people who can work patiently, understand finance, and appreciate the satisfaction of resolving an account-opening application.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers orderly, enterprising, and investigative work (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 稳妥 + 规则感」凑一块的人——证要核得真也要录得准，效率和合规要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细致与规则」——证要核得真，资料要录得准，合规要守得死。适合细心、坐得住、对金融有感觉的人，也享受把一笔开户理顺的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好守序、企业、也研究（常规 C + 企业 E + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine sustained focus, steady hands, and a love of precision. They must understand drawings, grind materials accurately, and reject even the slightest deviation.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops coordination among hands, eyes, and drawings. You must understand tolerance drawings and create accurate prototypes with steady hands and close attention. It suits people who can remain focused, enjoy precision, and accept responsibility for dimensions.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and organization (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把坐得住、手稳、爱精度凑一块的人——图要读得懂，料要磨得准，差一丝都不行。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练手眼加图纸——你既要读得懂公差图纸，也要手稳心细把样件做准。适合坐得住、爱琢磨精度、又愿意对尺寸负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也事务（务实 R + 钻研 I + 事务 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who are physically strong, sharp-eyed, and disciplined. Rugged work requires precise judgment, and safety boundaries are never negotiable.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction in this field comes from applying force in the right place. A rock weighing several tons is not opened through brute force, but by identifying the correct fracture and grain so one strike separates it cleanly. Quarry work is rugged, but only experienced workers understand its technique and feel.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「体格好、眼力准、又守得住规矩」的人——粗犷的作业里有精细的判断，安全的底线一步都不能让。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在于「把力用对地方」：一块几吨的巨石，不是靠蛮力砸开，而是找准裂隙和纹理，一下下去刚好分开。采石场的工作粗犷，但里面的门道和手感，只有干过的人懂。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 企业型 E + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Sales Representatives, Wholesale And Manufacturing, Except Technical And Scientific Products

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine extroversion, resilience, and financial sense. Goods must sell, and payment must come back.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops both firmness and flexibility. You need to calculate prices and negotiate while cultivating trust. It suits outgoing, resilient people willing to pursue one deal for a long time.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be enterprising, organized, and practical (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 抗压 + 会算」凑一块的人——货要卖出去，钱也要收回来。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「刚和柔」——既要会算账谈价，也要经营信任；适合外向、抗压、又愿意为一单跟很久的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好开创、规矩、也务实（企业 E + 常规 C + 实际 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine love for children, patience, and communication skills. Discipline must remain stable, struggling students need support, and growth requires attention.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops patience plus communication. You must maintain the classroom rhythm while gradually helping students with weak foundations understand. It suits people who enjoy working with children, can focus, and are willing to take responsibility for growth.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social, Artistic, and Enterprising preferences (Social S + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 教师助理（不含高等教育）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把爱孩子、有耐心、善沟通凑一块的人——纪律要稳，差生要带，成长要盯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练耐心加沟通——你既要hold住课堂节奏，也要把基础薄弱的学生一点点带明白。适合爱孩子、坐得住、又愿意对成长负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、创造、也经营（社会 S + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy the challenge of talking an impossibility into a possibility, telemarketing gives the most immediate feedback. Every call is an instant test, and closing the sale brings an intense sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The advantages of this career are its low barrier to entry and rapid feedback. It requires no particular academic background and directly develops communication skills. Change a script today, and tomorrow's conversion rate reveals the result. Strong telemarketers can earn as much as white-collar professionals, and the role is the first stepping stone for many exceptional salespeople.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「把不可能聊成可能」的挑战，电销会给你最直接的反馈——每一通电话都是即时考试，成交的那一刻，成就感拉满。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的好处是「门槛低、反馈快」：不用学历背景，练的就是沟通；今天话术改一下，明天成交率就见分晓。做得好的电话销售，收入不输白领，而且是很多销售高手的第一块跳板。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C + 现实型 R

breadcrumb.label: Textile Winding, Twisting, And Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The sense of security comes from simple, visible output. A package winds evenly and fully, machines run without alarms, and production records reconcile. For people who dislike complicated relationships and prefer dependable work, this certainty is rare.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work suits people who prefer predictable machinery and limited interpersonal demands. Everyone tends assigned machines, keeps yarn feeding smoothly, joins broken ends, and completes quality sampling. At the end of the day, full yarn packages provide tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 纺织、机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行的踏实感来自「简单但看得见的产出」：一筒纱线在你手里绕得饱满均匀，机台运转平稳不报警，产量记录对得上——对不喜欢复杂人际、愿意踏踏实实干活的人来说，这种确定性很难得。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合「机器规律性强、不靠嘴皮子」的人：车间里每个人各守各的机台，把纱线喂顺、把断头接好、把质量抽检做好，一天下来看着一筒筒饱满的纱线，踏实感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people fascinated by mechanics who also have steady hands. When an old watch that stopped years ago begins ticking again in your hands, the satisfaction is something an office cubicle can never provide.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most captivating part of this work is the satisfaction of breaking something down and rebuilding it. An old watch the customer thought was beyond saving comes back to life after replacing a few parts, cleaning, and lubrication. The fulfillment of that revival is priceless.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「对机械着迷、手又稳」的人——当一块停摆多年的老表在你手上重新走起来，那种满足感，是坐在格子间里永远体会不到的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「化整为零再还原」的成就感：一块客人以为没救的老表，换几个零件、清洗上油后重获新生，那种「起死回生」的满足感，多少钱都换不来。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C
